title: Coefficient data for compact-support reduction towers
statement: For a prime l, finite extension E of Q_l with integer ring R, and schemes W, define A_n=R/(varpi^(n+1)), the direct quotient A_m to A_n for n<=m, its constant sheaf map, and the restriction-composition isomorphism to the completed coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-integral-derived-reduction]. For a compactification c define the restricted compact-support level Res_n F_n(K_n), and its transition by reduction followed by the specified compact-support coefficient square [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars]. Define the constant scalar action on completed module sheaves using the constant sections of R. These are exactly the coefficient definitions previously in the tower module, without alteration.

source.place: Coefficient definitions of the coherent tower, before the first proof step.

proof.text: Use ideal quotient factor maps and their composition law. Apply the normalized coefficient restriction-composition isomorphism. Define the transition as the displayed composite, and the scalar predicate by equality on every section.
